name: A visual, and what to notice in it
useWhen: A screenshot, diagram or dashboard has to be EXPLAINED — the audience needs telling what to look at and in what order.

focal.note: The visual dominates by area because the callouts exist to serve it. Shrink it and the annotations become the subject, which inverts the slide.

replacesNote: image-content-v3 frames a screenshot; this explains one. The distinct job among the media templates: bleed-steps puts an image beside a list, rel-hub-rings argues FOR a diagram, this one explains a visual the audience is looking at.

deviations.source: a Venn inside a radial dial inside an activation loop
deviations.why: Bespoke artwork drawn once for one argument. Only the annotation pattern generalises, and that is what this template is.
